description: Official record of a child's birth.
required_documents: Hospital Birth Slip or Midwife affidavit
rejection_guidance: If rejected because the birth is late (over 60 days), you must apply for a 'Late Birth Certificate'. This requires a signed affidavit on stamp paper and approval from the Assistant Director Local Government or Magistrate.
steps: Obtain birth slip from the hospital.
Visit the Union Council of your residential area.
Fill out the registration form and attach parents' CNIC copies.
